articles.title: 'Shooters fired at actor Tiger Shroff on 3rd attempt, did recce of other actors including Salman, Aamir': Mumbai Police
articles.summary: Mumbai police say Oct 18 shooters made a third attempt on Tiger Shroff after recce of Salman Khan, Aamir Khan, Akshay Kumar and Amitabh Bachchan; two injured.
articles.body: MUMBAI: The October 18 firing at actor Tiger Shroff was allegedly the third attempt by the shooters to target him, with the accused claiming during interrogation that they had conducted reconnaissance of several Bollywood actors before zeroing in on Shroff, police sources said.According to sources, the three shooters, Phool Singh, 19, Rehan Ansari, 19, and Rithik Mahato, 22, told investigators that in the first week of October, they allegedly received instructions from Lawrence Bishnoi gangster Anil Pandit to identify potential targets, including actors Salman Khan, Aamir Khan, Akshay Kumar and Amitabh Bachchan.The accused allegedly recced these actors but failed to locate them or found it difficult to get close to them. Pandit subsequently, through voice notes, instructed them to target Tiger Shroff, son of actor Jackie Shroff.During the second week of October, the accused allegedly learnt that Tiger regularly worked out at MMV Matrix Gym, owned by his family, on Linking Road in Khar.The shooters reportedly spotted the actor outside the gym on one occasion but were not prepared to carry out the attack.“They decided to return the next day at the same time, but Tiger did not turn up. They then asked an auto-rickshaw driver where they could get to see filmstars. The driver allegedly told them that they could spot Tiger Shroff at a ground near Pushpa Park in Juhu where he regularly comes to play football,” a source said.Acting on this information, the shooters allegedly lay in wait at the ground on October 11, but Tiger did not arrive. They subsequently returned on October 18, allegedly armed and prepared to execute the attack.The firing left Tiger’s driver and a vlogger injured, while the actor escaped with minor injuries. articles.title: De Pussycat Dolls a Gusttavo Lima: 5 histórias que explicam publicidade em letras de música | G1
articles.standfirst: Do e-mail vazado sobre o grupo pop americano aos cachês milionários para falar de bebida alcoólica no sertanejo, entenda como mercado testou transformar refrãos em vitrines.
articles.summary: Do e-mail vazado sobre o grupo pop americano aos cachês milionários para falar de bebida alcoólica no sertanejo, entenda como mercado testou transformar refrãos em vitrines.
articles.body:
O anúncio da primeira vinda das Pussycat Dolls ao Brasil, com show em São Paulo no dia 30 de outubro , é um bom motivo para relembrar uma movimentação curiosa nos bastidores da indústria musical.

A ideia de vender espaço publicitário dentro de versos e refrãos já pareceu ser parte de um futuro inescapável, mas o mercado precisou testar o formato na prática para entender o que realmente funcionava. E essa história tem a ver com nomes que vão das Pussycat até Gusttavo Lima.

Relembre cinco momentos que explicam esta tendência:

Em 2008, mensagens de um empresário chamado Adam Kluger caíram nas caixas de entrada de vários jornalistas por acidente. O objetivo dele era claro: vender espaço publicitário nas letras das Pussycat Dolls. Na época, liguei para o número de telefone que estava no rodapé do e-mail. O cara foi um pouco ríspido, mas resumiu bem o seu modelo de negócio:

"A gente tem as celebridades e eles têm o dinheiro".

Na mesma ligação, no entanto, ele garantiu que nenhuma música das Pussycat Dolls acabou sendo vendida.

Se as Pussycat Dolls passaram ilesas, outros artistas da Kluger Agency abraçaram a ideia. O rapper Flo Rida foi quem efetivamente comercializou seus versos. A música “Hey Jasmin” falava sobre a Live Jasmin, uma plataforma de webcam com modelos que funcionava como uma espécie de OnlyFans da época. Depois, ele lançou “Zoosk Girl”, dedicada ao aplicativo de namoro Zoosk, um precursor do Tinder.

A capa do álbum 'Doll Domination', lançado pelas Pussycat Dolls em 2008 — Foto: Divulgação

Essas iniciativas no fim dos anos 2000 criaram a expectativa de que a inserção paga de marcas nas canções seria massificada. Para os críticos, era o ápice da mercantilização musical. No fim, a experiência não decolou lá fora. A indústria concluiu que usar produtos de forma visual nos videoclipes funcionava muito bem, mas transformar o refrão em uma vitrine sonora pegava mal com os fãs.

Se a tática soou forçada para o pop estrangeiro, no Brasil, o mercado sertanejo encontrou nela uma fórmula de alto lucro. Gusttavo Lima faturou pelo menos R$ 1 milhão para citar o uísque Old Parr no sucesso “Zé da Recaída”, lançado em 2018. Dois anos depois, a dupla Zé Neto & Cristiano escancarou o formato com "Alô Ambev", uma faixa que transita exatamente no limite entre uma balada de sofrência e um jingle da Brahma.

5) A coca-cola gelada (e não remunerada)

Hoje, a venda de espaços diretos nas composições é algo raro. O mais comum segue sendo quando um artista cita uma marca sem ganhar cachê, apenas pela fluidez da narrativa. É o que acontece quando ouvimos nomes como Caetano Veloso e Lulu Santos cantando sobre política, juventude ou amor enquanto citam uma coca-cola gelada. Tudo orgânico e sem patrocínio. No fim das contas, o que vingou mesmo foram as parcerias visuais em clipes, cotas de turnês e redes sociais: todos querem as marcas por perto, mas quase ninguém quer abrir mão da própria letra.

articles.title: Jack Antonoff slams Ed Sheeran over Macklemore controversy, says he should have canceled tour: ‘Stand the f--- up’
articles.summary: The Bleachers frontman also stated that saying “Free Palestine” is “not in any way a strange, uncomfortable or controversial thing to say, it’s a deeply huma...
articles.body:
Jack Antonoff criticized Ed Sheeran for proceeding with his tour after Macklemore's removal.

The Bleachers frontman said that Sheeran should have opted to "cancel the whole f---ing tour, then play for free outside each venue" to "raise a bunch of money."

Antonoff told Sheeran to "stand the f--- up" and opined that saying "Free Palestine" is "not in any way a strange, uncomfortable or controversial thing."

Jack Antonoff doesn't think Ed Sheeran handled his recent controversy well.

The Bleachers frontman criticized the "Shape of You" singer for proceeding with his Loop tour after Macklemore was removed from the lineup due to objections to his pro-Palestine comments on stage.

Though he has expressed solidarity with Palestine for years, Antonoff said that he has "felt way more emboldened to say" "Free Palestine" in public and on stage since the Macklemore debacle. "It's not in any way a strange, uncomfortable or controversial thing to say, it's a deeply human thing to say," he told The Guardian . "If you think it is [controversial] you're lost in some other sauce that is so crazy."

Antonoff condemned Sheeran, who blamed Macklemore's removal from the tour on a promoter who objected to the rapper's comments.

"They're going to let some f---ing promoter tell me what I can say? Don't book me. I'll play for free outside," he said. "[Ed Sheeran] missed a massive, beautiful opportunity there: just cancel the whole f---ing tour, then play for free outside each venue, raise a bunch of money, rather than let a f---ing billionaire tell you what to do."

He added, "The reason it's not an anomaly or niche issue is because we all live in a world where billionaires are constantly telling us what to do. So stand the f--- up."

Entertainment Weekly has reached out to representatives for Sheeran for comment.

Macklemore made comments advocating for Palestinian liberation and criticizing Israel on stage during his opening set of Sheeran's show in New Jersey on Sept. 5. A week later, Messina Touring Group, the promoter of the U.S. leg of the Loop tour, told Rolling Stone that "We have been notified by venues on the upcoming U.S. tour dates that they will not allow a concert to take place with Macklemore on the lineup," prompting Macklemore's removal.

"To all of my Jewish brothers and sisters, criticism of Israel, criticism of apartheid, being against genocide, it in no way is criticism of you," Macklemore said during the show. "This message is for peace, love, for all human beings to be treated with dignity, respect, and equality."

Shortly after Macklemore's exit, all of the remaining musicians attached to the tour dropped out in solidarity, including opening acts Finneas, Aaron Rowe, and Lukas Graham, as well as Sheeran's backing band Beoga.

Sheeran released a statement refusing to take a side in the Israel-Palestine conflict, and wept on stage during his first concert after Macklemore's removal as he said, "I've had to take and make difficult decisions, and I am making mistakes, and I'm so sorry."

Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter .

Macklemore launched a three-concert "Free Palestine" tour in Europe, with all proceeds going toward organizations supporting Palestinian people.

articles.title: Neil Young Sues Trump Committee for $10 Million Over Use of ‘Rockin’ in the Free World’
articles.summary: The fundraising committee played the anthem at a rally this month despite a prior settlement barring such use without permission from Young himself, the laws...
articles.body:
Rock legend Neil Young has slapped a Trump fundraising committee with a $10 million lawsuit over the use of his song, "Rockin' in the Free World," at an Ohio rally this month.

According to the five-page filing obtained by Rolling Stone , Trump was "personally aware that a license would be required" to play the song at an event, and he also knew Young "has not and would not grant the required license." The unauthorized use happened despite a prior lawsuit and 2020 settlement in which Trump allegedly agreed never to use Young's music without permission, the new complaint states. (Trump is not named as an individual defendant in the Monday complaint.)

"'Rockin' in the Free World' is a blistering anthem that contrasts the hollow promises of American political rhetoric with the harsh realities faced by the poor, homeless, and forgotten," Young and his lawyers, Robert Besser and Scott Simmons, wrote in the new complaint. "The lyrics paint vivid street-level portraits of a mother discarding her baby, addicts lost in despair, garbage piling in the shadows of prosperity, while the repeated chorus delivers a savage irony, celebrating freedom that clearly isn't shared by all."

They added that the 1989 song, which was named Rolling Stone's best vintage rock song of 2026 , "is the opposite of everything that Donald J. Trump stands for."

There was no immediate answer to a request for comment sent to the White House, the Trump 47 Committee, and the Republican National Committee, which partnered with Trump to create the joint fundraising committee.

Young's legal sparring with Trump dates back to 2015, when Trump used the track during his now infamous Trump Tower announcement that he was running for president. Young immediately condemned the move.

"Donald Trump was not authorized to use 'Rockin' in the Free World' in his presidential candidacy announcement," a Young spokesperson said in a statement then. "Neil Young, a Canadian citizen, is a supporter of Bernie Sanders for President of the United States of America."

When Trump played the song again in 2018, Young objected again. "I asked him then, in a widely shared, public letter to cease and desist," Young wrote on his website at the time. "However, he chose not to listen to my request, just as he chooses not to listen to the many American voices who ask him to stop his constant lies, to stop his petty, nasty name-calling, and bullying, to stop pushing his dangerous, vilifying and hateful rhetoric."

Young, 80, filed the latest lawsuit in federal court in Virginia, where the fundraising committee is based. He said the song was played on Oct. 12 at a rally in Youngstown, Ohio, where Trump made a speech.

Young is far from the only artist to challenge Trump over the use of music at his political events. The White Stripes, Rihanna , Axl Rose, Pharrell Williams , Linkin Park, and the estates of Tom Petty and Sinéad O'Connor have all publicly objected to his use of their songs.

articles.title: Jay-Z to headline Super Bowl halftime show
articles.summary: Jay-Z has helped select artists for the last several Super Bowl halftime shows.
articles.body: Jay-Z has helped select artists for the last several Super Bowl halftime shows. Now, the 25-time Grammy winner and mogul will step into the performer role as the headliner for the 2027 show. The NFL and Apple Music announced the news on social media during Monday night’s game between the Dallas Cowboys and the Philadelphia Eagles, confirming recent reporting about the halftime show from Puck that cited industry sources. “GOAT’s out of the bag,” read the post, which featured a black-and-white video of Jay-Z in the stands with a goat on his lap as “Allow me to reintroduce myself,” the opening line of his song “Public Service Announcement (Interlude)” plays. Jay-Z’s entertainment company, Roc Nation, has been a partner with the NFL and produced the halftime show since 2019. “For several years, we’ve had the privilege of working closely with Jay-Z and Roc Nation, and I’ve seen the extraordinary impact he has had on the Super Bowl Halftime Show,” NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell said in a statement. “When we first reached an agreement with Roc Nation to produce the show, I had just one request: that Jay-Z take the stage himself one day, whenever the moment felt right to him. I couldn’t be more excited for fans around the world to experience the artistry, creativity and cultural impact he will bring to the Super Bowl stage.” Super Bowl 61 will take place Feb. 14 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, near Los Angeles. The game and the halftime show will air on ESPN, ABC and Disney+ and on mobile devices with NFL+. Jay-Z, whose real name is Shawn Carter, just wrapped his 30 Tour, which celebrated the 30th anniversary of his debut album, “Reasonable Doubt.” His final two shows were at SoFi. “From Reasonable Doubt to standing on the Super Bowl Halftime stage, this has been a journey,” he said in a statement Monday. “Thirty years of music, work, and culture on the world’s biggest stage. This run continues to be a dream come true.” During the tour, which featured stops in Paris, London and Jay-Z’s hometown, New York City, he brought up several guests, including his wife, superstar Beyoncé. It’s unclear whether Bey or any of Jay-Z’s many other famous friends and collaborators will make cameos during the halftime performance. Many artists who have headlined the event have brought on major stars. But several, including The Weeknd and Rihanna, chose to shine solo when they appeared at the event. Last year’s game, which was broadcast on NBC and Peacock, featured Bad Bunny as the headliner, with Lady Gaga and Ricky Martin making cameos. The performance was awarded seven Creative Arts Emmys this year, making it the most awarded halftime show in history. It was Bad Bunny’s first Emmy and Jay-Z’s third, with both artists serving as producers last year. Kendrick Lamar, who headlined the 2025 show, also took home an Emmy after he tackled the gig. Next year, said Apple’s vice president of music and international content, Oliver Schusser, fans can expect “an incredible show” from Jay-Z, whose “impact on global music culture is as profound as it is undeniable.”

articles.title: ‘Drishyam 3’ box office collection day 25: Ajay Devgn’s thriller drops 65% on fourth Monday, India net reaches Rs 369.95 crore
articles.summary: Ajay Devgn’s 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' is proving to be a resilient performer at the box office, despite collections slowing in the fourth week of its
articles.body: Ajay Devgn’s 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' is proving to be a resilient performer at the box office, despite collections slowing in the fourth week of its theatrical run. While the numbers have naturally dipped from the heights of its opening days, the thriller continues to draw audiences to cinemas and hold its ground against newer releases competing for attention.'Drishyam 3' box office collection day 25: Rs 1.05 crore net in IndiaAccording to Sacnilk, 'Drishyam 3' earned Rs 1.05 crore net in India on Day 25, playing across 3,127 shows. That marked a 65% fall from the day before. The film’s India net total now stands at Rs 369.95 crore, with its India gross at Rs 443.15 crore. Overseas, the Ajay Devgn-starrer added Rs 25 lakh on its fourth Monday, lifting its overseas gross to Rs 131.50 crore and taking its worldwide gross to Rs 574.65 crore.'Drishyam 3' week-wise collectionThe film began its run with Rs 245.50 crore in week one, followed by Rs 87.50 crore in week two and Rs 28.85 crore in week three. Its fourth week opened with Rs 1.40 crore on Day 22, then rose to Rs 2.65 crore on Day 23 and Rs 3 crore on Day 24. Day 25 brought a dip to Rs 1.05 crore, bringing the fourth-week total so far to Rs 8.10 crore.'Drishyam 3' started big, earning Rs 62 crore net on Day 1, then Rs 53.50 crore on Day 2 and Rs 61 crore on Day 3. Day 4 brought in Rs 21 crore, followed by Rs 19.50 crore on Day 5, Rs 15.50 crore on Day 6 and Rs 13 crore on Day 7, which put the first-week total at Rs 245.50 crore.In week two, the film made Rs 14.50 crore on Day 8, Rs 26.50 crore on Day 9 and Rs 22.50 crore on Day 10. Business then slowed to Rs 6 crore on Day 11, before picking up slightly to Rs 8.50 crore on Day 12, and dipping again to Rs 5.25 crore on Day 13 and Rs 4.25 crore on Day 14. The second-week haul stood at Rs 87.50 crore.The third week began with Rs 3.10 crore on Day 15, Rs 5 crore on Day 16 and Rs 6.25 crore on Day 17. Day 18 saw Rs 3.50 crore, Day 19 went back up to Rs 6.25 crore, and Day 20 and Day 21 added Rs 2.65 crore and Rs 2.10 crore respectively, taking the week’s total to Rs 28.85 crore.Entering its fourth week, the film collected Rs 1.40 crore on Day 22, Rs 2.65 crore on Day 23 and Rs 3 crore on Day 24.'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' plot, director and cast'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' is a crime thriller directed by Abhishek Pathak, with Ajay Devgn returning as Vijay Salgaonkar. Having escaped the law years ago, Vijay finds himself under fresh scrutiny when the probe into his family’s past reopens, putting the intricate alibis he created to shield them to the test. Tabu, Shriya Saran, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav, Rajat Kapoor, Prakash Raj and Jaideep Ahlawat also appear in the film, which arrived in theatres on October 2, 2026.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalised. articles.title: Melanie Laurent of 'Inglourious Basterds' fame joins Saif Ali Khan and Vidya Balan for Ritesh Batra's 'Long Years Ago'
articles.summary: French actor and filmmaker Melanie Laurent, best known her work in Quentin Tarantino’s ‘Inglourious Basterds’, has joined Saif Ali Khan and Vidya Balan in
articles.body: French actor and filmmaker Melanie Laurent, best known her work in Quentin Tarantino’s ‘Inglourious Basterds’, has joined Saif Ali Khan and Vidya Balan in filmmaker Ritesh Batra’s upcoming feature film ‘Long Years Ago’.The comedy-drama that went into production in Mumbai, is reportedly set in 1991 and revolves around a family that has spent years avoiding difficult conversations. According to the official description, ‘Long Years Ago’ “is the story of a family that has gone too long without saying the things that matter, and what happens when they’re finally forced to find the words.”Speaking about the project, Batra expressed his excitement about bringing the cast together. “I am tremendously honored to be working with Saif, Vidya and Melanie, and to see these great actors bring characters that are so close to my heart to life,” the filmmaker said to Deadline.Laurent also spoke about her long-standing connection with the director, revealing that they had discussed the possibility of working together years ago. “I met Ritesh fifteen years ago at the Marrakech Film Festival, and we shared this dream to meet in Mumbai one day. I immediately loved this new project, and I am more than honoured and happy to be a part of it,” she said in a statement to Deadline.Vidya, on the other hand, shared her excitement to reunite with Saif, decades after starring together in 'Parineeta'. She said, "There’s such a beautiful sensitivity and honesty to his storytelling. What makes this even more special is that I get to reunite with Saif after Parineeta, my very first film! I can’t wait to experience the magic of working with both Ritesh and Saif."Leading man Saif, also shared his excitement about the film and present the audience with a 'deeply moving story'.Batra first gained international recognition with his 2013 feature ‘The Lunchbox’, starring Irrfan Khan and Nimrat Kaur. The film premiered at the Cannes Film Festival and went on to become one of the notable Indian releases of the year. He subsequently directed ‘Our Souls at Night’, starring Robert Redford and Jane Fonda, and ‘Photograph’, featuring Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Sanya Malhotra, which premiered at the Sundance Film Festival.Laurent, meanwhile, has built an international career as an actor and filmmaker. She gained widespread recognition for her role as Shosanna Dreyfus in ‘Inglourious Basterds’ and has since appeared in several international productions.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Netizens respond to Rashmika Mandanna's post defending Vijay Deverakonda and their relationship: ‘Etna explanation to Vijay se expect kiya tha…’
articles.summary: Rashmika Mandanna shares a heartfelt statement defending her relationship with Vijay Deverakonda, addressing online criticism after their appearance on 'Koffee with Karan.' The couple receives both support and backlash from netizens. Read more about their journey and Mandanna's response to the ongoing debate.
articles.body: Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda's relationship has sparked a lot of interest online over the past couple of days. Following their first appearance as a couple on ‘Koffee with Karan,' many netizens criticised the actor for his comments. During the interview, he shared that he told Rashmika she had to ask him to marry her 100 times, while the actress revealed she spent an entire year convincing him before they agreed to tie the knot.Amid ongoing online criticism, Mandanna shared a lengthy statement about the matter, saying people do not need to worry about their relationship, as she is truly happy with Deverakonda. Netizens were quick to react to her post online, with many people sharing their support for the couple’s bond and relationship, while others still had their own qualms about the matter.Netizens react to Rashmika Mandanna’s post about her and Vijay Deverakonda's relationshipMany people flooded the actress’ comment section under the post with heart emojis, lending their support to the star and her relationship with Deverakonda. One person shared a comment and thanked the actress for her genuine words, while another person shared, “Every single word here is pure truth and so empowering! Thank you for speaking your heart out so gracefully, ma'am. Standing by each other through thick and thin is what true love is all about. We are always, always with you both!”One person wrote, “I appreciate this response... It seems she gets to live with a different version of him than the one coming across to us... Just have to trust she knows what is good for her instead of implying otherwise out of 'concern'," while another social media user added, “Such a lovely couple you guys are. Lots of love, Vijju and Rushiee.”Internet users also joked about Rashmika Mandanna’s lengthy post and called her outWhile there were many supporters, there were also comments from people who criticised the situation. One social media user joked about the ongoing debate in the comment section and wrote, “She proved once again 'how much she loves Vijay.' Vijay proved once again ‘how much he loves himself.’”Another similar comment on her post added, “If you can’t read all those pages of paragraphs, here’s a short summary for you: 'Rashmika loves Vijay, and Vijay loves Vijay too,'" while another person added, “Posting this was brave; leaving it open for comments was braver.” Another internet user resharing the post on his account and added a similar comment saying: “9 slides ki post daali hai inhone just to prove ‘Rashmika loves Vijay and Vijay loves Vijay too’”, further mentioning that Deverakonda simply shared a photo and the same video his partner has posted online, and barely wrote about the incident in the caption.Netizens call out Vijay Deverakonda for not sharing a post about the ongoing matterMany people online continued to call out the ‘Arjun Reddy’ actor, pointing out that while Mandanna took the initiative to share a lengthy post about the criticism online, he is still keeping quiet. One person wrote on Instagram, “No reply from him, typical," while another added, “Did he give a remark, birthmark, postmark, trademark, hallmark, watermark, or checkmark???”Another comment from a netizen added, “Brother is still asking his girl to answer all this s***. The problem wasn't taking time to answer the proposal, but the red flags were validated throughout the interview. The fact that he came across as too self-obsessed gave me jitters in a very bad way.” Another person called her and Deverakonda out and wrote, “Etna explanation to Vijay se expect kiya tha, not from you” (Such an explanation was expected from Vijay, not from you).Rasmika Mandanna’s statement about her and Vijay Deverakonda’s relationshipOn Monday, Mandanna officially shared a post on her account about the ongoing drama revolving around her relationship with Vijay Deverakonda. She started the post by commenting that she wanted to share her “lil’ 2 cents” on the matter.She continued, “I generally don't address these things because everyone has a right to their opinions. Sometimes, I even enjoy reading them and gaining a different perspective. But the current frenzy over our interview feels less like people having opinions and more like an angry mob looking for someone to vent at.”She provided clarification over the “100 times” comment that was made on "Koffee With Karan," writing that she was in shock over the ongoing hate and speculation about their relationship. She added, “First, it was never about the number of times or an entire year. That's where some of you got stuck. Yes, that conversation happened. But neither of us was looking for a grand proposal. The conversation was about him wanting both of us to take the time and space to understand each other, to be sure that despite all the highs and lows and the joys and stresses of life, this was what we wanted and the right time for it. And we did. We chose each other.”She also shared that neither of them was looking for a grand gesture and that she respected his decision to take a year to be more sure about things in life. She also commented on when it became a “bad thing” to be “obsessed” with your man. Mandanna also added, “Find a man who loves you so beautifully that even after you're married, you'd still want to tell him, ‘Let's get married.' I would do it a thousand times—100 is nothing. It's really that simple.”Lastly, she concluded the post by sharing a video of Deverakonda carrying her on his back, while she wrote in the post, “Love to all those who celebrate love and joy. And to everyone else ... Please find something that makes you happy, too.”Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda met for the first time in 2017 while working together on the set of their Telugu film ‘Geetha Govindam,' which was released in 2018. The pair started dating soon after they worked on their second film, ‘Dear Comrade,' together. They officially tied the knot on February 26, 2026, in Udaipur.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Chethan D’Souza reveals how Rajinikanth and Hrithik Roshan’s ‘Jailer 2’ scene was planned to give both stars equal attention; reveals Mohanlal performed driving stunt himself
articles.summary: Action director Chethan D’Souza has spoken about designing the action sequences for ‘Jailer 2’ and working with superstars Rajinikanth and Mohanlal.
articles.body: Action director Chethan D’Souza has spoken about designing the action sequences for ‘Jailer 2’ and working with superstars Rajinikanth and Mohanlal. He shared how the team planned the stunts while keeping the actors’ safety in mind and explained why Rajinikanth’s style and involvement make him special. He also discussed balancing Rajinikanth and Hrithik Roshan in a scene, explaining how the action choreography is planned to give both characters the right attention without one overshadowing the other.In a conversation with Variety India, the action director shared that action sequences involving big stars require careful planning. The team works on the emotions, build-ups and choreography well before filming begins.How Chethan D’Souza plans action for superstars“High-octane action in big-budget films, especially those featuring superstars, must be scripted and carefully planned. The emotions, build-ups and action need to flow together. We establish these moments in advance because the actors’ time and safety matter,” he said.He further added that creating a heroic moment is not always about how well an actor fights. A star’s style, swagger and screen presence also play an important role.“We consider how to bring the actor’s star appeal into the choreography. With stars, it is often less about how well they fight and more about their style and swagger. Safety remains central. We consider the actor’s age, capabilities and what looks convincing on screen, then design the action accordingly,” he said.Chethan revealed that Malayalam veteran Mohanlal performed a driving stunt himself under his direction, including driving at high speed. However, dangerous moments involving explosions and collisions with vehicles or aircraft require technology rather than being filmed live.Balancing Rajinikanth and Hrithik Roshan‘Jailer 2’ also features Hrithik Roshan in a special appearance with Rajinikanth. Chethan shared about balancing two major stars in the same scene begins with the script. The director explains the sequence, after which the action team develops the details and adds ideas to improve the scene.“That balance is established in the script, not improvised on set,” he said.He said the team plans everything, from a vehicle’s arrival and impact to the actor stepping out and the shots that follow. He said, “We work out details such as the vehicle’s arrival and impact, the actor stepping down, and the shots that follow to make the entrance iconic. Each character needs the right emphasis without overpowering or being overshadowed by the other. Hrithik’s character must work in harmony with Rajini sir’s. We plan this well before filming and assess whether it will work.”Chethan also shared about Rajinikanth’s involvement with the action sequences. He revealed that the Superstar approached the work with the enthusiasm of a newcomer.“He was completely involved and approached the work with the openness of a newcomer. I never felt, even for a day, that I was working with a superstar. He stays on set rather than retreat to his trailer, he watches our preparations, even for sequences involving pyrotechnics and sometimes comes over with ideas.”Chethan also remembered an incident in which another performer was nervous while reacting to Rajinikanth’s strike. As Chethan corrected the performer, Rajinikanth asked him, “Am I doing it right? Is what I’m doing okay?”“That humility, rather than an attitude of knowing everything, is part of his X factor and makes him a genuine collaborator,” Chethan said.Rajinikanth’s X factorChethan added that Rajinikanth’s screen presence and swagger make even simple actions distinctive. Whether he holds a knife or a gun, or simply looks at someone, the actor brings his own style to the moment.He has an unmistakable presence, style and swagger. Give him a knife, a gun or any object — or simply ask him to look — and he brings something distinctive to it. Although we must consider his age, he still comes up with ideas beyond what we have planned or imagined. Sometimes we explain only the sequence, without suggesting a particular gesture, and he surprises us with his interpretation. That is his X factor,” he said.Speaking of ‘Jailer 2’, the film has become the highest-grossing Tamil film of all time surpassing Rajinikanth his 2018 mega hit ‘2.0’. According to trade analyst Sacnilk, the film’s worldwide gross collection has crossed over Rs. 733.35 crore as of Day 12.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Sai Pallavi sees herself in her IPS officer role as Nithya Reddy in Dhanush and Mammootty starrer ‘OM’; says ‘Thank You for choosing me again’
articles.summary: ‘Ramayana’ actress Sai Pallavi will be playing an IPS officer in the upcoming Dhanush and Mammootty starrer ‘OM’ helmed by Rajkumar Periasamy.
articles.body: ‘Ramayana’ actress Sai Pallavi will be playing an IPS officer in the upcoming Dhanush and Mammootty starrer ‘OM’ helmed by Rajkumar Periasamy. After her character’s introduction in her first glimpse release titled ‘OM Special Duty’, the actress thanked the director for choosing her to play Nithya Reddy in his upcoming action entertainer.The makers introduced her character on Monday through a special video. Responding to the announcement, Sai Pallavi said she sees a part of herself in Nithya Reddy and expressed her gratitude to the director.Sai Pallavi sees her alter ego in Nithya ReddyRajkumar Periasamy shared the character-introduction video on X and praised the actress for her performance. “HER! The PERFORMER @Sai_Pallavi92, You will never cease to amaze! Here’s #SaiPallavi as #NithyaReddy, IPS, Naidupeta Ammayi frOM #OM,” he wrote.Sai Pallavi responded, “Dear @Rajkumar_KP sir, Thank you so much for choosing me again and this time to play Nithya Reddy! I see my alter ego in her.”This marks another collaboration between Sai Pallavi and Rajkumar Periasamy after their earlier film ‘Amaran’.According to the character introduction, Nithya Reddy is an IPS officer from the Andhra Pradesh cadre. After serving in the Andhra Pradesh Police, she joins the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) as an Additional Superintendent and works with Interpol.Her senior officers consider her honest, intelligent and experienced for her age. She is also the person leading Operation OM, which appears to be central to the film’s story.Cast of ‘OM’Meanwhile, Mammootty plays a character named Karthikeyan, while Bollywood actor Naseeruddin Shah is also part of the cast. Sai Pallavi and Sreeleela play the female leads, and the film’s tagline, ‘Chapter 1’, has led to speculation about a possible sequel.Release details and technical team of ‘OM’The film was originally planned for an October 16 release. However, Dhanush later announced a postponement, explaining that the team wanted to respect Rajinikanth’s ‘Jailer 2’, which arrived in theatres on October 15. The makers also decided against a Deepavali release after Suriya’s film had already been announced for that date.‘Om’ is scheduled to be released in theatres on November 20, 2026.Sai Abhyankkar has composed the music, Ezhil Arasu has handled cinematography, and Kalaivanan R is the editor.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Sonali Kulkarni on '26 years of Mission Kashmir', praise from the President and more: ‘I have done more than 100 films, but I haven't spoken’- Exclusive
articles.summary: As ‘Mission Kashmir’ completes 26 years, Sonali Kulkarni looks back at playing Neelima Khan in Vidhu Vinod Chopra’s film, her experience of working with
articles.body: As ‘Mission Kashmir’ completes 26 years, Sonali Kulkarni looks back at playing Neelima Khan in Vidhu Vinod Chopra’s film, her experience of working with Sanjay Dutt and Hrithik Roshan, and why the film continues to resonate with audiences. In an exclusive conversation with ETimes, the actor also recalls a memorable interaction with the then President of India, who recognized her for her performance as Ramabai Ambedkar in ‘Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar.' From revisiting films that were ahead of their time to wanting her work to reach a wider audience, Sonali reflects on her journey and the experiences that continue to inspire her.Sonali Kulkarni on completing 26 years of ‘Mission Kashmir’ and why Neelima Khan remains special"‘Mission Kashmir’ has completed 26 years, and I think, as an actor, I have worked on many films that were ahead of their time. ‘Mission Kashmir’ also came at the right time because it was a film made by Vidhu Vinod Chopra himself. Vinod was not only the producer but also the director, which was rare for him.I was really touched by the way he treated all the characters and the way he sketched Neelima Khan, my character. She is a woman who has her sensibilities, spine, and pride intact. She doesn't fear telling her world, her love, and her son that philosophy is one thing and love is another.You need to understand what a nation has sacrificed. You need to understand the facts before you decide that you want to have animosity towards someone.I really liked Neelima Khan's character and the way Vinod treated her. She is Sanjay Dutt's wife and Hrithik's surrogate mother. We talk about women not getting meaty roles, and here is Neelima Khan, standing strong with an immense amount of love, affection, and pride in her heart," she expressed.Sonali Kulkarni on working with Sanjay Dutt: ‘He told me not to take tension'Sonali recalled, "I remember Sanjay being absolutely easy, chilled out, and extremely cooperative on the set. He supported me so well and asked me to relax. He said, ‘Aisa tension leke mat kaam karo.’We had a small scene, which we used to call the bedroom scene. There was nothing like that; it was just a husband and wife, with the wife blushing because they were teasing each other about who said ‘maa’ first and who said ‘papa’ first.It was a very cute scene and filled with affection. But the way the unit started calling it ‘the terrace wala scene’ or ‘the aangan wala scene’ eventually made it our ‘bedroom scene.'I started feeling nervous, and I was given a sleeveless gown. We didn't even have to do anything in the scene. So Sanjay finally told me, ‘Dekh, pehle main nervous rehta hoon aise scenes mein. Uske aage tu bhi nervous rahegi, toh scene kahin nahi jaayega. So, let's relax. It's just a dialogue scene.’He was very sweet."Sonali on witnessing Hrithik Roshan's growing stardom during the shoot"Hrithik, till about 90 percent of the film, had not become the frenzy and heartthrob of India that he later became. But during the last schedule of ‘Mission Kashmir,' I could see the change. There were so many people on the sets just to catch a glimpse of Hrithik, and there used to be security on the set.Hrithik and I got to do the same scene that we had done for our audition, so it was fun," she shared.Sonali opens up on whether ‘Mission Kashmir’ could be made today"Whether ‘Mission Kashmir’ could be made today. It is a unique film because of the time when it was made. Today, we are seeing a lot of films about spies, two nations, and betrayal.But of course, ‘Mission Kashmir’ will always stand apart from the crowd because it is based on strong emotions. If it were made today, I would have still suited the part. We are talking about 26 years ago, and I still had the courage to play Neelima Khan. It goes without saying that I would do anything for Vinod because he's such a sensitive director.It's a lovely thought to imagine having Hrithik, Preity, Sanju, Jackie Sir, and everyone in the film, and we should actually remake the film with Vinod Pradhan's cinematography, Shankar-Ehsaan-Loy's music, and such lovely costumes. We don't have Nitin Desai, though, who was the production designer," she said.On audiences revisiting her films and the beauty of cinema"As I said earlier, yes, I have worked on films that were ahead of their time. People are revisiting ‘Mission Kashmir’. They keep watching ‘Taxi No. 9211.' They keep watching ‘Daayraa’ nowadays. And they keep watching ‘Dr. Ambedkar.'I feel this is the beauty of cinema. You cannot revisit a theater performance in the same way. Though there is an exception, people keep watching ‘Sakharam Binder’ also, which we had shot about 20 years back when Vijay Tendulkar sir was still there with us.But that's the beauty of cinema. My husband and I started watching 'Omkara'. Both of us were talking about certain films, and we somehow missed ‘Omkara’. We can watch it today, and it's such a joy to see the times and the actors, who are ever-evolving. It is so wonderful to see Kareena, Saif, Ajay, and Konkona in that phase of 'Omkara.'In so many of my films, I can see my speech, voice quality, pitch, and body language varying. We have such a rich audience in India. I love reading it when audiences notice the nuances in one's performance,"Biggest misconception about Sonali Kulkarni"The misconception about me has nothing to do with my acting abilities, but many people think that I reside in Pune. I am originally from Pune, and I was the first one among my contemporaries to shift to Mumbai. I remember so many actors from later generations taking the path I took, although they didn't copy me. I shifted to Mumbai much earlier.I never shared a room in a hostel or lived on a cot basis. I have really nice memories of my rented houses. I lived in a chawl in Dadar, then rented a house, and had the smallest studio apartment, which I am very proud of to this day. Then, of course, I bought my own house.As for other misconceptions, I can't really say. I am very happy. I am not publicity-shy, and I have always felt that my work should reach people. Perhaps that is one misconception I would like to fight against in the coming years. I want my work to reach a wider audience because I have done more than 100 films and so much work over the years.Both the volume and quality of my work matter to me. I haven't spoken aloud enough about my own work, but I am coming out of that shyness, which is a welcome phase for me," the actress clarified.On the President of India's recognition for her performance as Ramabai Ambedkar"When we were invited by the President, I remember the security and even what I was wearing. Hrithik and Sanjay were both wearing denims and light blue shirts. The screening was over, and then we had high tea, which was a very magical experience. We were given saucers, then empty cups, then spoons, followed by tea decoction, milk, sugar, and biscuits.You are not exactly awkward, but you are overwhelmed when the President of India is standing close to you and you are having chai with him.Vidhu Vinod Chopra was introducing all of us. He said, ‘This is Sanjay Dutt,’ and went on to introduce him. Then he introduced Hrithik Roshan as the heartthrob of India, with many adjectives.I was standing a little behind when the president looked at me and asked, ‘Are you Rama?’Instinctively, I looked back, thinking there was someone standing behind me. Vinod realized that the president was talking to me and said, ‘No, no, this is Sonali Kulkarni. She played Neelima Khan in the film that you saw just now.’The president said, ‘Of course, I know that.’ He called me closer and asked, ‘Did you play Rama Ambedkar in a film called Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar?’I said, ‘Yes, sir.’ He told me that he had watched my film the previous month and said, ‘What a performance. I loved the film.’He went on talking about me and the film ‘Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar.' I can't tell you how touched I was, how smitten I was.And he didn't stop there. Everybody was speechless. He called his family and close friends and introduced me to everyone. He said, ‘Look who's come. Sonali, who played Ramabai in Dr. Ambedkar. Let's have a photo with you.’That was the epitome of glory or recognition for me, and it remains so to this day. If the first citizen of my country recognizes me so sharply and treats me so fondly, what more could I ask for in life?I should only strive to work better and better, work harder, pour my heart into my work even more, and make our Tricolour feel proud of what I am doing in my career. I have been so driven ever since that day. And that is all, thanks to ‘Mission Kashmir's screening at the President's residence," she concluded with a smile.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Diljit Dosanjh visits Taj Mahal ahead of Aura India Tour; singer shares glimpses from Agra
articles.summary: Ahead of his India Aura Tour, Punjabi singer Diljit Dosanjh made a surprise visit to the iconic Taj Mahal in Agra on Tuesday.
articles.body: Ahead of his India Aura Tour, Punjabi singer Diljit Dosanjh made a surprise visit to the iconic Taj Mahal in Agra on Tuesday.The singer shared an adorable video capturing glimpses of his visit to one of the Seven Wonders of the World. From posing at different iconic spots to happily waving at his fans, Diljit made the most of his time at the historic monument.Keeping his style game on point, the singer sported a quirky grey T-shirt paired with a red jacket, baggy blue jeans and his signature white turban, serving effortless cool vibes as he explored the Taj Mahal."WAH TAJ BOLIYE #wondersoftheworld AURA INDIA TOUR 2026," he posted.Meanwhile, Diljit is all set to perform in Delhi on October 30. Recently, his upcoming concert made headlines after reports emerged that the Delhi Police had denied permission for his performance at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Delhi, citing security threats, short notice, and festive-season law-and-order commitments.However, a day later, the Delhi Police has granted permission for Diljit's concert at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium. The decision came after multiple meetings between Delhi Police officials and the organisers, who presented detailed security plans to address the concerns raised.Following these discussions, permission for Diljit Dosanjh's concert was given.The booking platform also issued a statement confirming that the concert will go ahead as scheduled.Following the Delhi show, the India leg of the tour will move to Indore, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Lucknow. articles.title: Aitana, 27 años y propietaria de tres viviendas: "A mí también se me ha dicho que soy una especuladora por lo que conté en 'La Revuelta"
articles.standfirst: La artista española vendió una de sus propiedades, según revela en GQ
articles.summary: La artista española vendió una de sus propiedades, según revela en GQ
articles.body: El problema de la vivienda sigue preocupando a gran parte de los españoles. La dificultad para acceder a una vivienda en alquiler e, incluso, para adquirir un inmueble no para de aumentar. Aunque es un contratiempo que, especialmente, afecta a las personas de a pie, las estrellas de nuestro país no se quedan al margen. En su última entrevista para GQ, Aitana ha sido muy sincera al respecto. Hay que recordar que la cantante ya tuvo una pequeña polémica tras una aparición en ‘La Revuelta’. Allí dijo tenía cuatro viviendas: una en España, una en Miami y dos en alquiler. De momento, tras el revuelo generado decidió vender una, mientras que la otra la mantiene arrendada, pero “con unas condiciones que no tienen nada que ver con lo que está pasando en el mercado a día de hoy”. A pesar de crear una sociedad inmobiliaria, destaca que es solo para sus propiedades. Sobre sus palabras en ‘La Revuelta’, recuerda que no tenía “conciencia” de lo que era el tema. Además, después se pudo “meter más a fondo” para conocer el problema. A pesar de su posición de “privilegio”, tiene claro que debe usar su altavoz para denunciar la situación. Aitana es contundente tras haber pasado por muchas críticas: “No especulo con la vivienda ni lo voy a querer hacer nunca”. Tampoco rehuye de su obligación fiscal en nuestra nación: “Me compré una casa en Miami para poder trabajar allí, pero tributando siempre en España, porque también dicen que a las personas que ganan más, hay que freírlas a impuestos. Y estoy completamente de acuerdo”. Por último, la artista catalana se pronuncia sobre los grandes tenedores u otras estrellas que acumulan viviendas como inversión. Aunque ella no lo haría, tiene clara la decisión que tomaría al respecto si tuviera la oportunidad: “Tampoco estoy de acuerdo con que una persona tenga 10 casas, pero si las tiene, que se le apliquen todos los impuestos que correspondan”.

articles.title: 'Udta Teer' box office collection Day 5 [LIVE]: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan’s spy comedy eyes steady Tuesday hold, chases Rs 25 crore India net as worldwide gross nears Rs 35 crore
articles.summary: Directed by Aakash Kaushik and starring Ayushmann Khurrana alongside Sara Ali Khan, the action-spy comedy 'Udta Teer' continues its theatrical run on Day
articles.body: Directed by Aakash Kaushik and starring Ayushmann Khurrana alongside Sara Ali Khan, the action-spy comedy 'Udta Teer' continues its theatrical run on Day 5. Following a solid first weekend and a steady Monday, the film now focuses on maintaining steady mid-week momentum to cross key domestic and overseas benchmarks.With global gross collections comfortably navigating past Rs. 33 crore, 'Udta Teer' faces the critical task of maintaining low single-digit drops through Tuesday and Wednesday. The primary objective for the theatrical run is to secure an India net total above Rs. 25 crore by the end of its initial 7-day week. Additionally, continuous overseas returns will be vital as the project targets the Rs. 40-crore worldwide gross milestone entering Week 2.'Udta Teer' domestic box office runThe film opened with Rs 4.10 crore net across 6,265 shows on Day 1, with an India gross of Rs 4.83 crore. Day 2 jumped by nearly 77% to Rs 7.25 crore, and Day 3 rose by about 13% to Rs 8.20 crore. That made an India net of Rs 19.55 crore and a gross of Rs 23.37 crore for the weekend. The first Monday, Day 4, brought Rs 3.25 crore across 5,805 shows, which took the India net to Rs 22.80 crore and the India gross to Rs 27.21 crore.‘Udta Teer’ overseas collection and worldwide totalOverseas, the film made Rs 1.50 crore on Day 1, Rs 2.25 crore on Day 2 and Rs. 2 crore on Day 3, which brought the weekend total to Rs 5.75 crore and the worldwide gross to Rs 29.12 crore. Day 4 added about Rs 1 crore in the daily figure, and the overseas gross is reported at Rs 6.75 crore. Together with the India gross, the worldwide total is Rs 33.96 crore.'Udta Teer' Day 4 collection live trackingAccording to Sacnilk, the film is running across 1,985 shows on Day 5 and has earned Rs. 0.37 crore net so far.This takes the India net to Rs. 23.17 crore and the India gross to Rs. 27.65 crore, with the final Day 5 number and the overseas figures tallied and reported at the end of the day.Day wise collections for 'Udta Teer'Day 1: Rs. 4.10 croreDay 2: Rs. 7.25 croreDay 3: Rs. 8.20 croreDay 4: Rs. 3.25 croreDay 5 [LIVE]: Rs. 0.37 croreTOTAL: Rs. 23.17 croreMore about 'Udta Teer'Marking the directorial debut of Aakash Kaushik, 'Udta Teer' is an action-spy comedy. The story follows Pakistani operative Bilal Ahmad (Ayushmann Khurrana), who suffers total memory loss after an unexpected blast during an undercover mission in India. Waking up with amnesia and convinced he is an elite officer with India's Counter-Terrorism Squad, he unintentionally turns against his handlers and sets out to dismantle his own intelligence network.The film features Sara Ali Khan alongside a supporting ensemble including Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Gulshan Grover, Mukul Dev, Suhail Nayyar, and Raghubir Yadav. The film bagged a U/A 13+ certificate by the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) with a runtime of 137 minutes (2 hours 17 minutes).DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and data in this article are compiled from diverse public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. articles.title: Dilli ki Gal Ban Gayee with Sukhbir
articles.summary: He entered to the beats of the dhol, made Korean hearts to the audience and performed in true Punjabi spirit.
articles.body: He entered to the beats of the dhol, made Korean hearts to the audience and performed in true Punjabi spirit. From Gal Ban Gayee to the fan-favourite Oh Ho Ho Ho, the Prince of Bhangra, Sukhbir, got Delhi grooving as he brought Nykaaland, a three-day beauty fest at NSIC grounds to a close on Sunday. “I wasn’t sure if I should say it but I think the girls have more energy here. Girls, you have to show the boys how to do bhangra! That’s your job today,” he said.A special tribute to his fatherAmid whistles and cheers, Sukhbir blew kisses to the audience. Sharing a special anecdote, he said, “Mere pitaji ne puri umar babaji da kaam kitta hai, kirtan kiya hai, jab tak menu yaad hai. Jo bhi shayari likhi, upar wale ke liye likhi. Chhabbis saal pehle maine apne pitaji se request kari ki mere liye ek gaana likhdo aur agla gaana unhone mere liye likha. This (Sauda Khara Khara) is a song that means more to me than others. Do saal pehle pitaji hume chhod ke chale gaye lekin main unki taraf se yeh aap sab ko dedicate karna chahta hoon. Thank you very much for coming and making this an amazing time for us.”From childhood faves to the stage “Bahut log kehte hain, ‘I’ve been listening to your songs since I was a child. I grew up on them. Main bachpan se sunta aa raha hoon.’ Hum bhi fan hote hain kuch artistes ke, toh main bhi kuch artistes ko bachpan se sunta hua aa raha hoon. There’s one song that was very popular jab main bachha tha. And I got the opportunity to sing the song with the son of the original artiste,” he shared before performing Dowain Jaaniya, which he recorded with H Dhami. The original was sung by Heera Group in 1988. Taking the audience down memory lane, Sukhbir also revisited his Bollywood debut, recalling his first song for Hrithik Roshan. “Mera pehla gaana jo maine Bollywood films ke liye gaaya tha, that was for Hrithik. Let’s see if you remember it,” he said before performing Dhoom. Sukhbir ended his set with another round of Oh Ho Ho Ho before exiting with a knuckle crack, the classic ‘nazar na lage’ gesture for the Delhi crowd.A hit-filled set by the Bombay Rockers A day before Sukhbir took the stage, The Bombay Rockers had set the festive mood with a high-energy performance. Their setlist included popular tracks such as Rock Tha Party and Ari Ari, getting the audience moving to their signature blend of pop and Punjabi beats.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘Mission Kashmir’ turns 26: Jackie Shroff shares montage featuring Sanjay Dutt, Hrithik Roshan and Preity Zinta
articles.summary: Bollywood star Jackie Shroff revisited memories of his 2000 film 'Mission Kashmir' and shared a video montage featuring stills from the action drama,
articles.body: Bollywood star Jackie Shroff revisited memories of his 2000 film 'Mission Kashmir' and shared a video montage featuring stills from the action drama, which also starred Sanjay Dutt, Hrithik Roshan and Preity Zinta.The video features Sanjay Dutt as police officer Inayat Khan, Hrithik Roshan in an intense look as Altaaf Khan and Preity Zinta in her iconic look from the song, Bumbro.Directed by Vidhu Vinod Chopra, 'Mission Kashmir' was released on October 27, 2000. The film also featured Jackie Shroff and Sonali Kulkarni in important roles.The story revolved around Altaaf, a young boy whose family is killed during a police operation led by Inayat Khan. Inayat later adopts him, but Altaaf's life changes when he learns the truth about his family's death.The film is also remembered for its music composed by Shankar-Ehsaan-Loy. Songs such as 'Bumbro', 'Rind Posh Maal', 'Chupke Se Sun', 'Socho Ke Jheelon Ka' and 'So Ja Chanda' became popular among music lovers.'Bumbro', sung by Shankar Mahadevan, Jaspinder Narula and Sunidhi Chauhan, was one of the film's most popular songs and stood out for its Kashmiri folk influences.Interestingly, Anurag Kashyap was involved in the film's development but left the project midway.Another interesting fact is that Shankar-Ehsaan-Loy appeared on screen in 'Rind Posh Maal', bringing the music composers into the video alongside the song's Kashmiri-inspired visuals along wiyh Hrithik Roshan.Talking about Jackie Shroff, he is known for remembering important dates and milestones in the film industry, and regularly takes to his social media to wish fellow actors on their birthdays and mark special occasions.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Srinidhi Shetty calls Rs 7–8 crore remuneration reports rumour; ‘How can I ask for such huge amount?’, talks about playing Venkatesh’s wife in ‘Aadarsha Kutumbam’
articles.summary: Actress Srinidhi Shetty became popular with the ‘KGF’ franchise and is gearing up for the release of ‘Aadarsha Kutumbam House No.
articles.body: Actress Srinidhi Shetty became popular with the ‘KGF’ franchise and is gearing up for the release of ‘Aadarsha Kutumbam House No. 47’, starring Venkatesh Daggubati and directed by Trivikram Srinivas. Ahead of its theatrical release, the actress addressed the buzz around her that she demands Rs 7–8 crore as remuneration for a film. She dismissed the reports as rumours.In a conversation with SCREEN, while discussing her upcoming film, Srinidhi Shetty said she has acted in only a few films so far and questioned how she could demand such a large amount.“After the success of the KGF films, they say that I am asking for Rs 7 to Rs 8 crore. I have acted in few films so far. When that is the case, how can I ask for such a huge amount as remuneration? So, it is just a rumour,” she said.Srinidhi Shetty says money is not her prioritySrinidhi Shetty also shared that earning money has never been her only goal. She added that she could have worked in many more films if money had been her main motivation, but she prefers choosing projects based on their stories and characters.“If earning money was my only goal, I could have acted in 30 to 40 films over the last few years. But I do not sign films just for money. I give priority to good stories and quality characters,” she added.The actress has appeared in six films over eight years and admitted that she would like to work more frequently. “I am pretty instinctive with scripts. I want to do more films but they are not coming to me,” she said.Srinidhi Shetty responds to ‘AK47’ and ‘Blast’ comparisonsDuring the interaction, Srinidhi Shetty also addressed comparisons between ‘Aadarsha Kutumbam House No. 47’ and the recently released film ‘Blast’. She said the two films are not similar in their stories, even though both feature family elements and action.“There are no similarities between the two films. Just because both of these films have family elements and action involved, people think they are the same. But that is not true,” she said.She explained that films belonging to the same genre are often compared, but that does not mean their stories are alike. The actress also revealed that ‘AK47’ marks her first attempt at comedy.“This is the first time I have done comedy. I have never done comedy before. So I don’t know how it will come out. It is a good blend of crime, comedy and dark comedy,” she said.Srinidhi Shetty on playing mother in ‘Aadarsha Kutumbam’Srinidhi Shetty also spoke about playing a mother early in her career, saying she had no hesitation about taking on the role. She explained that she does not want to limit herself to one type of character or genre.About ‘Adarsha Kutumbam’Speaking about the film, ‘Adarsha Kutumbam’, Srinidhi Shetty plays Venkatesh’s wife and the female lead. The film also stars Nara Rohith, Nivetha Pethuraj, Yuvina, Raj Prajwal, Rao Ramesh, Satya, Brahmaji, Vennela Kishore and Raghu Babu in key roles.‘Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47’ was originally announced for release on October 2 during Gandhi Jayanti but was later shifted to October 9. articles.title: Ravi Kishan’s ‘Mera Yaar Bajrangi - Dosti Ho Toh Aisi’ to arrive in theatres on Diwali 2027
articles.summary: Actor-politician Ravi Kishan's upcoming devotional drama has been christened 'Mera Yaar Bajrangi - Dosti Ho Toh Aisi', which has been locked to light up
articles.body: Actor-politician Ravi Kishan's upcoming devotional drama has been christened 'Mera Yaar Bajrangi - Dosti Ho Toh Aisi', which has been locked to light up the screens on Diwali, next year.Mahaveer Jain Films announced the title and the release date of the film on Tuesday, as per a statement.The poster features Ravi Kishan in a powerful yet minimal avatar. It shows a divine fist bump - one hand belongs to a common man wearing a rudraksha and raksha sutra, and the other belongs to Bajrang Bali himself, adorned with a Shri Ram naam patka and rudraksha mala, with a divine spark connecting the two. The visual perfectly captures the film's tagline, 'Dosti Ho Toh Aisi'.The film is said to be the story of a common man's friendship with his God, the statement said.A source close to the project said, "It's just not a religious film; it's about the relationship between a Bhakt and Bhagwan. In today's time, when everyone is looking for a true friend, what if Bajrang Bali himself becomes your yaar? That's the emotion behind this film."Ravi Kishan, who has been on a stellar run with both OTT and theatrical releases, will be seen in a never-before-seen avatar as a devout common man from the heartland.The film is written and directed by Amit Aarryan and presented by Mahaveer Jain Film and produced by Mahaveer Jain Films in association with Ratpack Stories.Ravi was last seen in 'Mirzapur: The Movie' alongside Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, Divyenndu Rasika Dugal, Shweta Tripathi, Harshita Gaur and Jitendra Kumar to name a few.It acts as an interquel set during the first season of the Prime Video television series 'Mirzapur'. The film follows old enemies who resurface and new contenders emerge in a brutal war for Mirzapur's throne.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
